verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring work is a fair question for a robotics software framework, but the evidence pack documents no feature for scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. The launch system coordinates multiple nodes as a one-off start-up, not a recurring schedule. Topic statistics being published 'at regular intervals' is an internal metrics behavior, not a user-schedulable job capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
